description_en: Queries statistics of alerting records associated with a specified event, grouped by rule, attack categorization, or member accounts
description_zh: 按规则、攻击分类或成员账号分组统计指定事件的关联告警
name: DescribeAlertAggAnaIpItemGroupWithIncident

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，默认 10，最多 100 条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the security event. You can call ListIncidents to obtain this value
parameters.help_zh: 安全事件 ID，可从 ListIncidents 获取
parameters.name: incident_uuid

parameters.help_en:
The list of attack results. Valid values:
1: attempted attack.
2: successful attack.
3: compromised
parameters.help_zh: 攻击结果列表。1 表示攻击尝试，2 表示攻击成功，3 表示失陷
parameters.name: attack_result

parameters.help_en: The ID of the alert rule. You can obtain this value from the AlertRuleId field in alert aggregation records
parameters.help_zh: 告警规则 ID。可从告警聚合记录的 AlertRuleId 获取
parameters.name: rule_uuid

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the attacker or victim. Exact match is used
parameters.help_zh: 攻击者或受害者 IP 地址，采用精确匹配
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en: The filter condition for the associated domain of the alerting record
parameters.help_zh: 告警关联域名的筛选条件
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The grouping dimension. Valid values:
RULE_UUID: rule.
CATEGORY_ID: attack categorization.
MEMBER_UID: member accounts
parameters.help_zh: 分组维度。RULE_UUID 表示规则，CATEGORY_ID 表示攻击分类，MEMBER_UID 表示成员账号
parameters.name: group_by

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response content. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English.

Default value: zh
parameters.help_zh: 返回内容的语言。zh 表示中文，en 表示英文，默认中文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The list of alert risk levels. Valid values:
1: low-risk alert.
2: medium-risk alert.
3: high-risk alert
parameters.help_zh: 告警风险等级列表。1 表示低危，2 表示中危，3 表示高危
parameters.name: risk_level

Data.description_en: The query result or operation response data
Data.description_zh: 查询结果或操作返回数据

List.description_en: The list of results on the current page

items.description_en: The statistics of an alert group
items.description_zh: 一个告警分组的统计结果

AlertNum.description_en: The number of associated raw alerts

AttackResultSummary.description_en: The attack result distribution and alert counts. The key try indicates attempted attacks, success indicates successful attacks, compromise indicates compromised, and fail indicates failed results (5, 6, 7, 8). Keys with a count of 0 are not returned
AttackResultSummary.description_zh: 攻击结果分组及告警数。键 try 表示尝试，success 表示成功，compromise 表示失陷，fail 表示失败结果（5、6、7、8）；数量为 0 的键不返回

FirstAlertTime.description_en: The time of the first alert in this group within the query range. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
FirstAlertTime.description_zh: 该组在查询范围内首次告警的时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳

GroupByKey.description_en: The group identity. When GroupBy is set to RULE_UUID, this value is the rule ID. When GroupBy is set to CATEGORY_ID, this value is the attack categorization ID. When GroupBy is set to MEMBER_UID, this value is the member account UID. These values can be used as the RuleUuid, CategoryId, or MemberUid filter parameter in DescribeAlertAggAnaIpItemWithIncident respectively
GroupByKey.description_zh: 分组标识。GroupBy 为 RULE_UUID 时是规则 ID，为 CATEGORY_ID 时是攻击分类 ID，为 MEMBER_UID 时是成员账号 UID。可分别用于 DescribeAlertAggAnaIpItemWithIncident 的 RuleUuid、CategoryId、MemberUid 筛选

GroupByName.description_en: The display name of the group. When grouped by rule or attack categorization, this value is the corresponding name. When grouped by member account, this value is the text representation of the member account UID
GroupByName.description_zh: 分组展示名称。按规则或攻击分类分组时为相应名称；按成员账号分组时为成员账号 UID 文本

LastAlertTime.description_en: The time of the most recent alert in this group within the query range. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
LastAlertTime.description_zh: 该组在查询范围内最近一次告警的时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳

RelateMemberUidCount.description_en: The number of member accounts associated with this group
RelateMemberUidCount.description_zh: 该组关联的成员账号数量

PageNumber.description_en: The current page number. Pages start from 1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
PageSize.description_zh: 每页记录数，默认 10，最多 100 条

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of records that match the query conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合查询条件的记录总数

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request failed

Message.description_en: The description of the request result or the failure reason
Message.description_zh: 请求结果说明或失败原因

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于排查请求问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败
